note: Only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, the full SilkJS runtime; the default engine runtime has no `AbortController`.
No device sensor APIs.
No device sensor APIs.
`navigator.clipboard.readText()` and `writeText()` work on the system clipboard. `read()`, `write()` and `ClipboardItem`, for images and other types, are missing.
Only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, the full SilkJS runtime; the default engine runtime has no `atob` or `btoa`.
No audio output or Web Audio API.
There is no `auxclick` event; `pointerdown` and `pointerup` carry `button` for every button.
A service worker feature for pages that sync while closed.
No `navigator.getBattery()`.
`sendBeacon` sends data as a page unloads; an app can send it with `fetch` before it quits.
Printing events are about printing documents.
Only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, the full SilkJS runtime; the default engine runtime has no `Blob`.
Only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, the full SilkJS runtime; the default engine runtime has no `URL.createObjectURL`.
Only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, the full SilkJS runtime; the default engine runtime has no `BroadcastChannel`.
Only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, the full SilkJS runtime; the default engine runtime has no `MessageChannel`.
There are no `copy`, `cut` or `paste` events. Inputs copy and paste on their own, and `navigator.clipboard` reads and writes text.
Lines go to the host's standard error.
Only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, the full SilkJS runtime; the default engine runtime has no `console.time` and `console.timeEnd`.
No form validation API: inputs have no `checkValidity()` or `setCustomValidity()`.
Cookies belong to pages in a browser.
CORS restricts what pages may fetch from other origins; an app's requests are not under the same-origin policy.
No `createImageBitmap`.
No `navigator.credentials`.
Only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, the full SilkJS runtime; the default engine runtime has no `crypto.subtle`.
No `CSS.supports()`. The [Can I use](/can-i-use/) page lists what stylesheets support.

A node listens only to the tree's own event types: `addEventListener` with any other type throws, so custom events cannot be sent to nodes. `App.runtime(Runtime.node())` has `CustomEvent` and `EventTarget` for objects of your own.
No device orientation or motion events.
A browser privacy setting for websites.
There is no document or `<script>` element.
XPath queries a document; a Silk UI app has a tree of nodes, not a document.
A deprecated API for editable documents. Rich inputs have `format()` and `toggleMark()` for the same job.
No `Range`. Inputs report their selection as `selectionStart` and `selectionEnd`.
`node.scrollTo(x, y)` works. `scroll()`, `scrollBy()` and the options form (`behavior: "smooth"`) are missing.
No media playback, so no encrypted media either.
No `EventSource` in either runtime; with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, read the stream with `fetch`.
A header for pages and their frames.
Only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, the full SilkJS runtime; the default engine runtime has no `fetch`.

Files dropped on a window arrive as `File`-like objects with a `name` and a `path`, but the default runtime has no `File` or `Blob` to read them. `App.runtime(Runtime.node())` has `File`, `Blob` and `node:fs`.
No `FileReader` in either runtime. With `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, read a `Blob` with `text()` or `arrayBuffer()`.
No workers, and no `FileReaderSync`.
A deprecated sandboxed file system for pages. With `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, use `node:fs`.
No Gamepad API.
No `navigator.geolocation`.
Layout cannot be read synchronously. A node's `layout` event reports its box (`event.bounds`) after each layout that changes it.
Only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, the full SilkJS runtime; the default engine runtime has no `crypto.getRandomValues`; `Math.random` is not cryptographic.
No device sensor APIs.
Only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, the full SilkJS runtime; the default engine runtime has no `navigator.hardwareConcurrency`.
About the address of a page. `@silkui/foldkit` keeps an address in memory for its router.
`performance.now()` runs on the host's clock. `performance.timeOrigin` is there only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`.
No camera access.
IME composition works in inputs, but there is no API to read or steer the IME from script.
No IndexedDB in either runtime. With `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, keep data in files with `node:fs`.
No IndexedDB in either runtime.
No file or directory picker yet; files can be dropped on a window.
Inputs have `setSelectionRange()`, `selectionStart` and `selectionEnd`, but a plain input counts them in UTF-8 bytes, not UTF-16 string indices as the web does. Rich inputs use string indices.
Silk UI has no HTML. Nodes are made with `createBox` and `createText`, or by a framework.
No `IntersectionObserver`.
No `IntersectionObserver`.
No device sensor APIs.
Nodes have no `matches()` or `closest()`. (`@silkui/foldkit`'s elements have `closest` and `querySelector`.)
No `matchMedia`, so script cannot ask for `prefers-color-scheme` or a width. Stylesheets' `@media` queries work.
Inputs have no length limit attribute; cut the value in an `input` listener.
No media capture.
No media capture or recording.
No media playback.
No Web MIDI.
No `MutationObserver`. The app makes every change to its nodes itself.
No `localStorage` or `sessionStorage` in either runtime. With `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, keep data in a file with `node:fs`.
No file pickers. With `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, `node:fs` reads and writes any file the app may.
Times the loading of a page.
No `navigator.connection`.

Importing `@silkui/core` gives `Notification`: `new Notification(title, { body })` shows a desktop notification, with `click` and `show` events. Permission is always granted; `close()`, icons and actions do nothing.
No real-time communication APIs.
No `navigator.onLine` or `online` and `offline` events.
No device sensor APIs.
About pages entering and leaving a browser's history.
Script cannot ask whether the window is visible or minimized.
No WebAuthn or passkeys.
Browser checkout for shopping pages.
No `navigator.permissions`.
A header for pages and their frames.
No picture-in-picture windows.
No pointer lock.
Embeds and navigates between pages.
No device sensor APIs.
Server pushes to a page's service worker. An app can hold its own connection, with `WebSocket` under `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`.
Callbacks run before the window's frames, with the frame time.
No `requestIdleCallback`; use `setTimeout`.
No `ResizeObserver`. A node's `layout` event reports its box (`event.bounds`) after each layout that changes it.
Times the resources a page loads.
No WebRTC.
No `screen.orientation`.
No `scrollIntoView()`; scroll the container with `scrollTo(x, y)`.
No `scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()`.
No `getSelection()` over the app's text. Inputs have their own selection.
Reports server timings of a page's requests to its devtools.
Service workers make pages work offline; an app is offline already.
Only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, the full SilkJS runtime; the default engine runtime has no `setImmediate`; `setTimeout(callback, 0)` and `queueMicrotask` are there.
Shared workers share one worker between pages.
No speech recognition.
No speech synthesis. To have a screen reader speak, use `announce()` from `@silkui/core`.
Web SQL is deprecated and gone from browsers.
No camera or microphone access.
Only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, the full SilkJS runtime; the default engine runtime has no `ReadableStream`, `WritableStream` or `TransformStream`.
Only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, the full SilkJS runtime; the default engine runtime has no `TextEncoder` or `TextDecoder`.
There are no touch events; use pointer events.
Guards HTML injection into a document; Silk UI has no HTML.
A deprecated API, replaced by WebAuthn.
Only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, the full SilkJS runtime; the default engine runtime has no `URL`.
Only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, the full SilkJS runtime; the default engine runtime has no `URLSearchParams`.
Only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, the full SilkJS runtime; the default engine runtime has no `performance.mark` and `performance.measure`.
No `navigator.vibrate`.
No screen wake lock.
No `element.animate()`. CSS transitions and `@keyframes` animations work through styles.
No Bluetooth access.
No serial port access.
No `navigator.share`.
No WebCodecs.
No WebGPU.
No HID device access.
No NFC access.
Only with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`, the full SilkJS runtime; the default engine runtime has no `WebSocket`.
No WebTransport.
No USB access.
Replaced by WebXR and gone from browsers.
No `Worker` in either runtime: an app's JavaScript runs on the UI thread.
No WebXR.
`postMessage` between pages and frames; an app has one realm.
No `XMLHttpRequest` in either runtime; `fetch` works with `App.runtime(Runtime.node())`.
Parses and serializes HTML and XML documents; Silk UI has no document.
